summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release announcing the cash dividend per share for an interim scrip dividend. On May 7, 2026, the company declared an aggregate EUR 400 million dividend, with a per-share amount of EUR 0.5578 for shares of EUR 0.01 nominal value. Shareholders may elect to receive payment in shares or cash, with a default of shares if no election is made. This is a routine dividend distribution, a capital return event, but is not a special-situation corporate action such as a tender offer or going-private. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report.
